operations.title: Flavor boundary weak-basis stabilizer and gauge-fixed tangent-intersection audit
Flavor boundary partners are discrete transverse sparse-gauge intersections of one weak-basis orbit
operations.summary: At all eight boundary textures the full stabilizer dimension is 2 and orbit dimension 25. The ambient complex sparse-support/orbit tangent intersection has dimension 7, but the real-positive one-phase gauge-fixed chart/orbit tangent intersection has dimension 0.

operations.title: Positive-dimensional equal-readout correspondence does not mean a continuous fixed-physical-point fiber
operations.summary: The ten-dimensional correspondence is a graph over changing physical moduli. At a fixed boundary physical point the gauge-fixed sparse chart meets the weak-basis orbit discretely and transversely.

operations.title: Classify flavor boundary arrows by weak-basis stabilizer double cosets
operations.summary: Reduce each explicit U(3)^3 intertwiner modulo the two-dimensional source and target stabilizers and test whether the four arrows lie in one or several disconnected correspondence classes.
